messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Realtime SLO alert: streaming endpoint /v1/live p99 > 1.5s in us-west-2 (p95=0.7s, p99=2.2s). Triggered by slo-detector at 01:03 UTC. Paging @maria (primary) and @sam (sre).

maria (oncall): ack. Starting triage. First: scope (regions/customers), second: quick mitigations, third: paging if customer impact > threshold.

pulse-bot: Synthetic canary failures detected: 3/5 streaming canaries timed out between 01:02:30-01:03:10 UTC. Canary latency samples: 2.1s, 2.4s, 2.0s.

sam (sre): dashboards -> https://dash.redwood/internal/streams?region=us-west-2&panel=tail show tail p99 spike starting ~01:01 UTC. No prod deploys in last 40m (deploy-bot: none). Queue depth for stream-workers spiked x4.

lee (eng-runtime): grabbing logs & traces. Running tail-sampler on hot pod: `kubectl logs -n prod stream-w-12 --since=5m | grep "stream_latency" | tail -n 80` -> lots of `stream_latency=2500ms` and `stall=read_kv` markers. Also seeing frequent `prefetch_retry` messages.

anjali (storage): storage metrics: us-west-2 KV layer showing tail latencies ~200-350ms starting 01:00 UTC concurrent with leader election churning (RAFT leader rotated twice). Investigating.

pat (support): customer-impact quick check: ~95 active streaming sessions affected; top customers: big-enterprise-1, analytics-inc. No high-severity escalations yet but login support tickets rising.

maria (oncall): ok, hypothesis: KV backend region instability causing repeated cache misses and worker stalls -> long tail. Immediate mitigations options: 1) enable local-prefix fallback (skip KV lookups), 2) steer new sessions to us-east, 3) reduce batch sizes to lower queuing.

sam (sre): enabling local-prefix fallback via feature flag for us-west-2 now: `POST /ops-api/flags` payload -> `{"flag":"stream_local_fallback","region":"us-west-2","value":true,"ttl":600}`. Response 202.

lee (eng-runtime): applying runtime config to skip KV calls on affected pods. Patch applied to 5/7 pods. Observing p99 drop to ~1.3s within 45s.

pulse-bot: Canary check after fallback: 5/5 canaries pass, median latency 0.9s, p99 1.35s.

maria (oncall): good. Sam, please also throttle batch size for streaming worker pool in us-west-2 from 16 -> 6.

sam (sre): batch-size change pushed via config: `stream.worker.batch_max=6` -> applied.

anjali (storage): investigating leader churn: saw election at 00:59:48 and 01:00:55 with spikes in commit latency. Tracing leader election cause.

pat (support): notified big-enterprise-1 and analytics-inc about degraded transcript quality (due to fallback) and latency mitigation steps. Both acknowledged and asked for ETA on restoration.

maria (oncall): status update: - Impact: p99 SLO breach for /v1/live in us-west-2, ~95 active sessions affected; - Actions taken: local-prefix fallback enabled (TTL 10m), batch size reduced, canaries executed; - Effect: p99 reduced from 2.2s -> 1.3s then to 1.1s after throttling; - Owner: anjali/storage to investigate root causes; sam/lee to coordinate re-enable plan.

sam (sre): recommend waiting for KV tail latencies to be stable <50ms across 3 consecutive 1m windows before rolling back fallback. Also propose adding a short-circuit circuit-breaker at runtime to avoid repeated prefetch retries when KV latency > threshold.

lee (eng-runtime): opened storage follow-up ticket STOR-482 for RAFT leader churn and trace artifacts. Captured heap snapshots, leases, and rpc traces.

anjali (storage): found that a sibling maintenance job triggered a transient IO freeze on 3 storage nodes causing leader elections. Rolling mitigations: pin leaders, increase election timeout temporarily, and schedule remediation. Will post timeline.

pat (support): created a support incident and informed top customers. No escalations to SEV yet.

maria (oncall): apply alert silence for this alert for 20m to avoid alert storms while we monitor.

pulse-bot: alert-silence applied for slo-detector (20m).

sam (sre): monitoring: p99 trending down: 2.2 -> 1.3 -> 1.05 over 8 minutes. Synthetic checks green. Leaving fallback active for now.

maria (oncall): wrapping up live mitigation: - Short-term: fallback + reduced batch + canary checks. - Mid-term: storage to remediate leader churn and validate KV stability. - Postmortem: sam to lead incident write-up, anjali to provide storage RCA, lee to include runtime changes and circuit-breaker proposal. Deliverables due EOD tomorrow.

anjali (storage): will provide timeline and ETA for full KV restore. Current plan: rolling repairs and more conservative eviction settings. ETA ~3 hours for verification.

maria (oncall): thanks everyone. If p99 regresses reopen this thread. Closing live-RCA loop for now. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated. Ticket STOR-482 created. Logged actions and timeline for postmortem.
